newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO PESO ENDS FIRMER FOR THIRD DAY IN ROW.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO PESO ENDS FIRMER FOR THIRD DAY IN ROW.

text.p: The Mexican peso closed firmer for the third session in a row on Wednesday as foreign investment flowed into the local stock and money markets, dealers said.
"Foreign investors jumping into the bourse have boosted the peso, although banks have kept it in check by exercising put options," a dealer said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart ended 2.6 and 2.5 centavos firmer, respectively, at 7.7800/7.7830 and 7.7780/7.7810 per dollar.
